exact_answers.detail: Same verdicts as majority: R3, R7, R10 wrong.

rigor.detail: Rigger gaps in R3 (no bound argument); R9 state table slightly muddled but answer right.

clarity.detail: Readable; one Final Answer inside prose instead of its own line.

functionality.detail: 8/10 met; sorting toggle works but arrow only on active column; LANDED state missing.

visual_design.detail: Functional; spacing rhythm uneven; inherits default font stack for headings.

code_quality.detail: Reasonable factoring; duplicated renderers for table and chart state.

accessibility.detail: aria-sort on table headers plus labeled buttons; contrast on muted text borderline.

responsive.detail: Media queries correct; chart resizes via container listener.

spec_correctness.detail: Envelope correct everywhere found; date query filter implemented; PATCH status machine has bug allowing cancelled -> cancelled.

security.detail: Rejects absurd bodies (>1MB); number coercion guarded; no dynamic code eval.

validation_errors.detail: Priority order exact; 422 lists all fields; strict ISO parser.

data_modeling.detail: Indexed appointments by doctor for overlap check; O(n) per insert acceptable.

design_answers.detail: D1 concrete (SELECT FOR UPDATE); D2 vague on token refresh; D5 failure mode is generic.

code_quality.detail: Mostly clean; some copy-pasted JSON builders.
